criteria: Provisions expressly conferring enforceable rights on data subjects with regard to processing under the binding corporate rules.
Provisions enabling data subjects to lodge complaints with the competent supervisory authority or before competent courts for breaches of the binding corporate rules.
Provisions establishing data subjects' right to redress and, where appropriate, compensation for damage caused by a breach of the binding corporate rules.

title: Personnel Data Protection Training
description: The contract requires data protection training for personnel with access to personal data.
criteria: Provisions requiring data protection training for personnel with permanent access to personal data.
Provisions requiring data protection training for personnel with regular access to personal data.
Provisions requiring the training to be appropriate to personnel's role and level of data access.

title: Third-Country Legal Order Handling
description: The contract contains writings addressing whether and how foreign court judgments or administrative decisions demanding personal data transfer or disclosure will be recognised or enforced.
criteria: Default non-recognition or non-enforceability of foreign judgments and administrative decisions compelling transfer or disclosure of personal data, absent a qualifying legal basis.
Recognition or enforcement is conditioned on an international agreement (e.g. a mutual legal assistance treaty) in force between the requesting third country and the Union or a Member State.
Preservation of other Chapter V transfer grounds (e.g. adequacy decisions, appropriate safeguards, derogations) as independent bases for transfer unaffected by this provision.

title: Consent-Based Transfer Derogations
description: The contract contains provisions regarding international transfers executing under explicit data subject consent.
criteria: Provisions addressing explicit data subject consent for specific transfers.
Clauses requiring communication of risks stemming from lacking adequacy decisions.
Clauses requiring communication of risks stemming from missing safeguards.

title: Contract Performance Derogations
description: The contract contains provisions governing international transfers strictly necessary for contractual execution.
criteria: Provisions addressing transfers necessary for performing contracts with data subjects.
Provisions addressing transfers executing pre-contractual measures requested by data subjects.
Provisions addressing transfers executing third-party contracts concluded in data subjects' interests.

title: Other Statutory Transfer Derogations
description: The contract contains provisions invoking other statutory derogations for international transfers absent adequacy or safeguards.
criteria: Provisions addressing transfers necessary for important reasons of public interest.
Provisions addressing transfers necessary for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.
Provisions addressing transfers necessary to protect the vital interests of the data subject or other persons unable to consent.
Provisions addressing transfers made from a public register open to consultation.

title: Legitimate Interest Transfer Exceptions
description: The contract contains provisions governing exceptional non-repetitive transfers based on compelling legitimate interests.
criteria: Clauses restricting qualifying transfers to non-repetitive occurrences.
Clauses limiting qualifying transfers to limited numbers of data subjects.
Clauses confirming compelling legitimate interests are not overridden by the data subject's interests, rights or freedoms.
Terms requiring controller assessment of transfer circumstances.
Provisions requiring suitable safeguards for transferred personal data.

title: Derogation Transfer Notifications
description: The contract contains terms regarding notification protocols for exceptional legitimate interest transfers.
criteria: Clauses requiring controller notification to supervisory authorities concerning exceptional transfers.
Clauses requiring controller notification to affected data subjects concerning exceptional transfers.
Clauses requiring notification of specific compelling legitimate interests pursued.

title: Transfer Derogation Documentation
description: The contract contains specifications regarding documentation of transfer derogation assessments.
criteria: Terms requiring written records of transfer circumstance assessments.
Terms requiring written records of implemented suitable transfer safeguards.
Clauses requiring derogation records inclusion within Article 30 registers.
